container: background-color: #f5f1e6; padding: 40px 14px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', 'Noto Serif SC', serif
p: font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #1f1d1a; margin: 0 0 18px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #1f1d1a; text-align: left; margin: 44px 0 20px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 3px double #1f1d1a
h2_first: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #1f1d1a; text-align: left; margin: 0 0 20px; padding-bottom: 10px; border-bottom: 3px double #1f1d1a
h3: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #9e2b25; letter-spacing: 3px; text-align: left; margin: 30px 0 14px; text-transform: uppercase
blockquote: border-top: 1px solid #c9c2b2; border-bottom: 1px solid #c9c2b2; padding: 16px 8px; margin: 0 0 18px; color: #55514a; font-size: 15px; text-align: left; font-family: Georgia, 'Songti SC', 'Noto Serif SC', serif
code: color: #3a362e; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
inline_code: background-color: #eae5d6; color: #9e2b25; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
list_item: font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.8; color: #1f1d1a; margin: 0 0 18px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: background-color: #1f1d1a; color: #f5f1e6; border: 1px solid #c9c2b2; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700
footer: text-align: right; color: #55514a; font-size: 13px; border-top: 1px solid #c9c2b2; padding-top: 12px; margin-top: 40px
p_first: font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.8; color: #55514a; border-left: 3px solid #9e2b25; padding-left: 14px; margin: 0 0 18px
